datasets.name: fraud_rate
queryLines:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    COUNT(*)
      * 100.0
      / (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM
          financial_guard.silver.transactions
      ),
    2
  ) AS fraud_rate_pct
FROM
  financial_guard.gold.fraud_card_alert

measures.name: active_count
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: high_risk_count
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_high_risk = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: country_mismatch_count
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN geo_country_mismatch = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: city_mismatch_count
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN geo_city_mismatch = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

title.value: Avg Risk Score by Customer Segment
